description: Module builds bundled into UPb Studio. scripts/fetch-modules.mjs installs web modules into ui/public/modules/<name>/ and services (kind "service") into their `out` folder, verifying sha256 (of the release archive). A web module with no url falls back to its local development build; a service with no url for the build platform is left out, and the `local` checkout is what development builds run instead (docs/service-bundle-contract.md).
